description: This Java source file defines a REST controller for category management in an e-commerce application, including endpoints for retrieving, creating, and deleting categories associated with merchant stores.

classes.name: ShoppingCategoryRESTController
classes.description: REST controller providing endpoints for category operations such as retrieval, creation, and deletion within a merchant store context.

methods.name: getCategory
methods.description: Handles GET requests to retrieve a category by ID for a specific store, considering language preferences.

methods.name: createCategory
methods.description: Handles POST requests to create a new category for a specified merchant store.

methods.name: deleteCategory
methods.description: Handles DELETE requests to remove a category by ID from a specified merchant store.
